jobs.title: Vice President of Finance
jobs.description:
We are seeking a strategic, commercially oriented, and transformational Vice President of Finance to lead the business finance function across our Strategic Business Units and Segments. Reporting directly to the Chief Financial Officer and working from our Pittsburgh, PA headquarters, you will play a pivotal role in elevating the rigor, discipline, business partnership, and impact of our finance organization as well as partnering with the CEO and CFO on key operational initiatives.

As our Vice President of Finance, you will lead a team of Finance Directors and serve as the primary catalyst for strengthening financial performance management, accelerating profitable growth, optimizing working capital, and enhancing commercial excellence across the enterprise. You will drive a step change in how finance supports business decision-making by creating a more proactive, data-driven, engaged, and influential finance organization.

You will work closely with senior business leadership, Corporate Strategy, Controllership, Treasury, Tax, M&A, Investor Relations, and other Finance Centers of Excellence to ensure world-class financial stewardship while enabling growth and value creation.

PPG offers excellent Medical, Dental, & Vision Benefits; matching 401k + retirement savings; and Paid Vacation, Holiday pay.

Main Responsibilities:
Enterprise Business Partnership
- Serve as the senior finance leader and trusted advisor to business leadership across our Strategic Business Units and Segments as well as corporate functions.
- Drive fact-based decision making by providing actionable financial insights, strategic guidance, and performance analysis.
- Challenge business assumptions and influence operating decisions to maximize shareholder value.

Financial Performance and Profitability
- Lead efforts to improve profitability through disciplined performance management, pricing excellence, margin expansion initiatives, and resource allocation.
- Establish greater accountability and rigor around financial commitments, forecasts, business reviews, and performance interventions.
- Partner with business leaders to identify opportunities for growth, productivity, and operational improvement.

Working Capital Excellence
- Drive enterprise focus on working capital optimization, including inventory management, receivables performance, and cash generation.
- Establish clear performance metrics and accountability mechanisms to improve cash conversion and capital efficiency.

Finance Function Transformation
- Elevate the capabilities, engagement, and effectiveness of the business finance organization.
- Build a highly proactive finance team that acts as a strategic business partner rather than a traditional reporting function.
- Develop new standards for financial analysis, forecasting accuracy, decision support, and timely management insights enabled by better data, dashboards, and analytics.

Leadership of Finance Directors
- Lead and develop Finance Directors supporting our business units and segments as well as corporate functions.
- Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and talent development.
- Build a robust pipeline of finance talent through intentional succession planning, stretch assignments, mentoring, and development of high-potential leaders across business units, segments, and corporate functions.
- Ensure consistency of financial practices while encouraging innovation and business partnership excellence.

Cross-Functional Finance Leadership
- Coordinate closely with Controllership and other Finance Centers of Excellence to ensure business finance activities are aligned with enterprise processes, reporting requirements, and governance expectations.
- Partner across Treasury, Tax, Investor Relations, M&A, and Corporate Strategy to deliver integrated financial leadership.
- Champion best practices and leverage enterprise-wide financial expertise to improve business outcomes.

Strategic Planning and Investment Decision Support
- Lead the financial aspects of strategic planning, annual operating plans, long-range planning, and investment decision support.
- Develop and evaluate robust business cases for capital investments, growth opportunities, acquisitions, and strategic initiatives, ensuring clear assumptions, financial rigor, risk assessment, and value creation expectations.
- Provide financial analysis and recommendations that support enterprise prioritization, while ensuring business-sponsored investments are aligned with strategic objectives and return expectations.

Qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field required
- MBA, CPA, CFA, or equivalent advanced qualification preferred
- 15+ years of progressive finance leadership experience within a global, complex organization
- Demonstrated success leading business finance organizations and partnering directly with senior operating executives
- Strong track record of driving profitability improvement, performance management, and business transformation
- Experience leading large, geographically dispersed teams
- Deep understanding of commercial finance, FP&A, financial operations, and strategic planning

jobs.title: Financial Controller Denmark
jobs.description:
Bliv en del af vores team som Financial Controller for Danmark.

Vil du være tæt på forretningen og samtidig sikre, at tallene altid er korrekte? Som Financial Controller for Danmark får du en central rolle for en finansprofil, der trives med høj faglighed, præcision og forretningsnær sparring.

Du kommer til at arbejde hands-on på tværs af hele den finansielle cyklus, fra månedsafslutning til forecasting, og du får et tæt samarbejde med Local Finance, Plant Operations og Business Finance-teams. Dette er ikke en rolle, hvor du leder andre eller sætter strategien på afstand. Det er en rolle, hvor din tekniske nøjagtighed, nysgerrighed og pålidelighed direkte bidrager til forretningens performance.

Du refererer til vores FP&A Finance Manager for Nordics, Baltics and Kazakhstan. Det giver dig adgang til et stærkt front-office finance team, samtidig med at du bliver understøttet af et større team i PPG’s Shared Service Center i Brno. Du får ansvar for den end-to-end månedlige rapporteringsproces og bidrager til forecasting-cyklusser i tæt samarbejde med øvrige Finance-teams. Rollen har ikke personaleansvar, så du kan fokusere fuldt ud på finansiel ekspertise, eksekvering og forretningspartnerskab.

Lokation: Søborg, Danmark

Arbejdsmodel: Hybrid

Dine ansvarsområder
- Gennemføre den fulde månedsafslutningsproces for tildelte enheder i henhold til US GAAP, herunder journal entries, accruals, provisions, intercompany transactions og reclassifications, samt sikre korrekte P&L-, balance sheet- og cash flow statements med variance analysis af høj kvalitet.
- Understøtte annual planning og periodiske forecasts ved at indsamle inputs, indlæse og afstemme tal samt opbygge driver-based models for revenue, COGS og Opex.
- Sikre nøjagtighed i P&L og proaktivt løse eventuelle problemstillinger i samarbejde med Brno Shared Service Center.
- Udarbejde forretningsanalyser og rapportering, der hjælper lokal ledelse med at forstå performance drivers og træffe informerede beslutninger.
- Understøtte konsolidering af overhead costs og fremadrettet forecasting, afstemme payroll accounting og vedligeholde detaljeret cost center reporting, herunder tracking af Opex og headcount, samt sikre korrekt dataindsendelse i ERP- og BI-værktøjer inden for fastsatte deadlines.
- Sikre høj SOX compliance og stærke internal controls gennem grundig dokumentation og control evidence, understøtte interne og eksterne audits med detaljerede schedules og forklaringer samt, efter behov, bidrage til statutory audit i samarbejde med lokale rådgivere.
- Bidrage til procesforbedringer ved at dokumentere SOPs, identificere muligheder for simplificering og understøtte automatisering i Excel og BI-værktøjer.

Kvalifikationer
- Uddannelse inden for finance, accounting eller et beslægtet område.
- 4-6 års erfaring inden for controlling, accounting eller FP&A.
- Stærk viden om US GAAP. Erfaring med SOX og internal controls er et krav.
- Avancerede Excel-kompetencer. Erfaring med SAP og Power BI er en fordel.
- Kendskab til Anaplan vil være en yderligere fordel.
- Flydende dansk og engelsk, både mundtligt og skriftligt.
- Struktureret, detaljeorienteret og pålidelig, også når deadlines er korte.
- Trives i en global matrixorganisation.
- Hands-on tilgang og motiveret af eksekvering. Dette er en individual contributor-rolle uden direkte personaleansvar.

Det tilbyder vi
- Et internationalt arbejdsmiljø med eksponering mod Nordics, Baltics and Kazakhstan i en Fortune 500-organisation.
- Direkte samarbejde med erfarne finance leaders, som giver meningsfuld faglig udvikling fra første dag.
- Adgang til PPG’s globale learning and development-programmer.
- En konkurrencedygtig lønpakke, der matcher erfaring og markedsniveau.

As a Senior Customer Service Operations Manager, you will play a key role in shaping service delivery excellence across the region, driving continuous improvement initiatives, and building strong partnerships with business stakeholders. jobs.title: Operations Director, Aerospace Transparencies
jobs.description:
As the Operations Director for Aerospace Transparencies, you will develop and maintain an organization for the Global Transparencies business that supports both Commercial and Operational strategies.  You will be responsible for providing strategic, developmental, and tactical direction of the business to drive Operational Excellence and Continuous Improvement. Is responsible for delivering products safely, on quality, on time and at targeted costs with oversite of operations and supply chain. You will report to the GM of Global Transparencies. This is a hybrid position can be based out of Sylmar, CA, Grand Prairie, TX., or Huntsville, AL.

You will manage:
- 4 Manufacturing Sites in 2 different Countries (Sylmar CA, Huntsville AL, Grand Prairie, TX in the USA & Casaletto Vaprio, Italy)

- The Transparencies Supply Chain CoE Manager

Key Responsibilities
- Be actively engaged in Safety and Quality; lead by example and ensure operational discipline and compliance with both company and regulatory standards and requirements are fulfilled for all departments on site.

- Regularly monitor and review Environmental, Health, and Safety performance; ensure compliance and continuous improvement in striving for a risk-free manufacturing environment.

- Build and develop an operations and supply chain culture that has a bias for action, commitment to value-added services/processes, and a sense of accountability and leadership.

jobs.description:
Program Manager – Aerospace Transparencies
Huntsville, AL

Are you a passionate and driven Program Manager who is looking to take their career to new heights?  Then look no further than this opportunity with PPG's Aerospace business! We are looking for someone who is able to see the future of aviation transparencies and take our exceptional products to the next level!

In the Aerospace Transparencies Program Manager  role you will be responsible for overseeing the program lifecycle management (PLM) from concept through development into sustainable production and into sunset of aerospace transparencies for fixed wing aircraft and rotorcraft applications (military and commercial). In this role you will be involved in managing cross-functional teams, coordinating with suppliers and customers, ensuring compliance with aerospace standards, and driving program schedules, budgets, and quality objectives to successful completion for a portfolio of programs.

This is a On-site role reporting to the Huntsville, AL facility.  In this role you will report to the Site Lead -  Program Manager.

Responsibilities:
- Lead end-to-end program management across the PLM lifecycle (Gates 2-7), driving new product introduction, production, sustainment, and sunset activities while meeting customer requirements, business objectives, budget, schedule, quality, and performance targets.
- Develop and execute integrated program plans, including schedules, budgets, resource allocation, capital funding requirements, forecasts, and gate reviews, with authority to approve or fail program gates and implement corrective actions as needed.
- Build, lead, and coordinate cross-functional Integrated Project Teams (IPTs) across Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Procurement, R&D, and Operations to ensure seamless program execution and value stream alignment.
- Serve as the primary customer interface for all programmatic activities throughout the product lifecycle, leading stakeholder engagement, negotiating technical changes, supporting commercial and contract activities, and ensuring customer satisfaction.

- Ensure compliance with customer requirements, industry regulations (FAA, EASA, MIL-STD), and internal quality standards, while providing regular executive-level reporting on program status, financial performance, schedule health, and risk assessments.

Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s degree in engineering or related discipline required.
- Aerospace specific industry experience is preferred.
- Minimum of Five (5) years of program management or engineering experience in aerospace or defense industries, with specific experience in transparencies or related components.

With a strong manufacturing focus, the HRBP will strengthen S&OP, optimize the Business Unit's industrial network, and support organic growth through workforce and production capacity planning. Reporting to the Global HR Director, the role partners closely with HR leadership at the Aerospace ASC in Atlanta.

Key Responsibilities:
- Lead the global execution of HR strategies and initiatives, navigating local business complexity while championing enterprise alignment and a clear, consistent ONE PPG message.
- Serve as a strategic HR partner to B2B sales leadership, shaping sales org models, incentive design, and compensation frameworks aligned to go-to-market strategy, growth targets, and market dynamics.

- Enable organic growth by partnering on production capacity strategy, anticipating workforce requirements, identifying capability gaps, and supporting timely resource and talent decisions.

- Demonstrated experience partnering with global, matrixed B2B sales organizations, including designing and supporting sales incentive plans.

- Possess cultural sensitivity and emotional intelligence to work successfully across borders, functions, and levels.

- Inspire and motivate team members to achieve single and team performance goals.

jobs.title: Commercial Territory Sales Manager - Automotive Refinish
jobs.description:
As a Commercial Territory Manager (CTM) on PPG's Automotive Refinish team, you will guide profitable sales growth and strengthening customer relationships within a defined territory covering Eastern Iowa. You will focus on commercial refinish solutions, with an emphasis on fleet, industrial, and commercial vehicle refinishing applications, supporting customers who demand high‑performance coatings, technical expertise, and reliable partnership. Reporting directly to the Commercial Regional Manager, the CTM operates remotely and serves as the primary commercial contact for both direct customers and distributor partners. You will expand PPG's market share by building strategic territory plans, applying technical product knowledge, and delivering customer support aligned with the Automotive Refinish portfolio.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage and grow sales within a defined territory, including existing direct accounts and distributor-managed accounts using a disciplined and defined approach.

- Serve as the primary representative and knowledge source for PPG Commercial Coatings in the assigned territory.

- Prospect, qualify, and convert new leads for both direct and distribution sales channels.

- Develop and maintain a robust commercial sales distribution network.

- Assess distributor capabilities and work to improve their performance through training and support collaboration with the sales team to review targets, develop strategies, and manage sales opportunities.

- Lead opportunity cadence calls and joint customer visits with distributors representatives to strengthen customer relationships and identify growth opportunities.

- Support and train PPG's digital tools at distribution and end user customers.

- Utilize CRM tools effectively to strategize, track, and manage territory activities.

- Deliver presentations and training sessions to distributors and end user customers on PPG products and value propositions.

- Develop, write and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) as needed.

- Monitor and understand the competitive landscape to form sales strategies.

- Manage and control an expense account responsibly.

- Demonstrate a proactive sales attitude with a focus on ethical decision-making and customer satisfaction.

- Handle multiple sales opportunities at various stages of the sales process simultaneously.

- Coach and support sales partners to enhance their effectiveness.

- Commit to continuous learning and complete all required training on time.

- Travel as necessary, up to 50% overnight, to support sales activities and distributor engagement.

Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in business, Marketing, Chemistry, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

- 5+ years of progressive experience in commercial coatings sales, automotive refinish, or an adjacent industrial market.

- Experience in sales development, negotiation, with the ability to establish engagement with prospects, customers, and distributor partners.

- Hands-on technical capabilities related to substrate preparation, painting processes and application

- Valid driver's license and willingness to travel.

PPG Industries
Birstall

Join a 16 billion turnover global organisation in an exciting and influential sales role!!

You will establish, maintain, and grow PPG architectural specification share across both private and public sector projects, within the Architect and Design community.

This is an office-based role covering a national portfolio of Architect and Design practices. It will involve goals for outbound contact with practices to develop our specification presence within the UK&I. There will be occasional travel each month to F2F client meetings and specification events.

You will report to the Commercial Excellence & PRGM Manager UK and Ireland.

This is an office-based role - 5 days per week at our facility in Birstall.

This is an individual contributor position.

jobs.description:

You will optimize commercial performance through working capital management, including accounts receivable control, demand forecasting, and inventory optimization. You will lead the implementation of global Marine business strategies, driving adoption of premium coating solutions to enhance customer value and profitable growth. You will develop and revitalize strategic marine accounts through targeted account management, customer engagement, and share-of-wallet growth across key industry customers. You will be reporting directly to PMC Business Manager.

- Build sustainable business growth and profitability by achieving sales, profit contribution, and cash flow goals through strategic customer management, pricing optimization, and market development plans.

jobs.title: Commercial Territory Sales Manager, South Dakota/Nebraska
jobs.description:
As a Commercial Territory Sales Manager, you will be responsible for developing profitable new business opportunities within the Light Industrial Coatings segment for the Automotive Refinish business. In this role, you will partner with assigned Territory Sales Managers and distributor partners to drive growth through the promotion and sale of PPG Light Industrial Coatings product portfolios.

Reporting to the Commercial Regional Sales Manager, you will dedicate 100% of your time to industrial and commercial sales growth, business development, and account management. This position requires up to 50% travel and covers the territories of South Dakota and Nebraska.

Key Responsibilities
· Identify and develop new market opportunities to drive industrial and commercial sales growth while expanding distribution channels.
· Execute key elements of the regional commercial growth strategy as directed by the Commercial Regional Sales Manager.
· Lead the onboarding, development, and successful launch of new distributor partners, including the creation of ongoing business plans and growth strategies.
· Collaborate with distributors and Territory Sales Managers to develop and implement effective sales strategies that achieve business objectives.
· Coordinate sales efforts across commercial distribution channels while educating distributor sales representatives on industrial coatings products, applications, and business opportunities.
· Deliver fleet and commercial product training programs to support sales teams, distributor personnel, and customers.
· Contribute to the development and implementation of sales training materials and programs to strengthen product knowledge and selling capabilities.
· Monitor market trends, customer needs, and competitive activity to provide insights that support regional marketing and growth initiatives.
· Identify and pursue direct sales opportunities in alignment with regional growth objectives.
· Assist in developing and securing regional and national account specifications as opportunities arise.

Qualifications
· Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, a technical discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and sales experience.
· Minimum of two years of experience in territory sales management, business development, or a related commercial sales role.
· Strong technical aptitude and understanding of sales processes and customer relationship management.
· Proficiency with CRM systems and commitment to maintaining accurate customer and opportunity records.
· Experience within the paint, coatings, automotive refinish, or related industrial manufacturing industry preferred.
· Excellent communication, presentation, relationship-building, and negotiation skills.
· Abil ity to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams and distribution partners.

Salary Range: $85,000 – $110,000 annually
Incentive: Sales Incentive Bonus plan eligible

jobs.description:
You will drive sales growth and market expansion for Protective Coatings in Luzon, with a focus on infrastructure projects. You will develop strategic relationships with architects, consultants, steel fabricators, contractors, distributors, and key accounts. You will also identify new business opportunities across segments such as data centers, water and wastewater infrastructure, railways, bridges, and government projects. You will support business growth through customer engagement, technical presentations, channel development while ensuring achievement of sales, profitability, inventory, and performance targets. You will report directly PMC Business Manager

Key Responsibilities
- Drive and achieve key business performance indicators (KPIs), including sales revenue targets, product contribution (%PC), accounts receivable-to-sales performance (%AR/Sales), and effective inventory management through accurate forecasting, optimized Days Sales Outstanding (DSO), and Days Inventory Outstanding (DOI).
- Drive the implementation of global Protective Coatings projects by promoting and growing premium product sales across key infrastructure segments, with a primary focus on data center developments.
- Promote PPG CPFP products to Architects / Designer / Consultants / Steel Fabricators
- Develop, strengthen, and re-activate key Protective Coatings accounts within the infrastructure segment, driving business opportunities across water and wastewater transmission projects, power sector accounts (PPA), government railway developments such as NSCR, bridge projects under DPWH, and other strategic infrastructure sub-segments assigned by the Protective National Sales Manager.
- Develop and expand distribution sales channels across Luzon by identifying, onboarding, and managing strategic distributors, strengthening market coverage, and driving sustainable sales growth for Protective Coatings products.
- Identify Customer needs, price analysis vs competitions, and submit tender.
- Ensure 100% usage of Salesforce, Quotation Manager and other available tools.
- Conduct Product and Technical Presentation to Clients

Qualifications
- Graduate from a University with BS Engineering a degree in Accounting, Marketing or Business.
- Minimum 5 years of sales experience, including at least 3 years within the coatings industry. Experience with leading coatings manufacturers such as AkzoNobel International Paint, Jotun, CMP Davies, Hempel, or other comparable competitors will be considered an advantage.
- Established relationships and proven business development experience with key Protective Coatings customers, including major engineering, construction, marine, and industrial organizations such as EEI Corporation, EEI Marine, AG&P, Amsteel, and San Miguel Corporation (SMC), will be a strong advantage.

This role is able to be fully remote within the Toronto/Mississauga, Ontario area. You will report to the Sales Director OEM and Aftermarket.

- Develop, maintain, and continuously refine comprehensive account plans to grow sales and margin improvements for all assigned accounts and prospects.

jobs.title: Technical Sales Manager EWI & Render
jobs.description:
Technical Sales Manager - EWI and Render
PPG Industries
Field Based

You will be the Technical Sales Manager for the Johnstone's Stormshield Render and EWI (External Wall Insulation) business. This is an important regional position responsible for expanding our relationships through multiple channels. You will have regular contact with Social Housing asset management teams, Design Engineers, Retrofit Designers, Architects and Contractors at all levels. Adopting a consultative approach to selling on many occasions which requires networking, and project management skills to help influence major construction and refurbishment projects.

You will report to the National Technical Sales Manager.

You will cover the southern region.

Key Responsibilities
- Survey, design and specify custom technical EWI & Render documentation / specification following business / industry standard requirements for main clients and contractors.

- You will develop a network of A&D practises, New Build designers, Retrofit designers and design engineers to work with the A&D development managers on opportunities relating to Render & EWI.

- Identify important social housing decarbonisation and retrofit refurbishment opportunities. Work with relevant asset management team, Eco manager and design/ delivery teams.

- Support the Johnstone's Stormshield PPG National network of approved installers. Delivering EWI approved applicator training to suitable contractors and individuals before the supply of any full EWI systems.

- Train, support and upskill, where required our PPG employees within the trade business to share basic technical understanding, best practice and product/ system training.

- Work within a set pricing structure and supporting the broader trade business with material / system calculations to secure sales.

- Adopt a consultative sales approach to uncover and secure new project leads into the pipeline and identify the main causes and considerations behind the projects.

- Develop specifications to meet the requirements of the project (Golden Thread Specs). You will ensure they are as unique as possible to PPG to minimise risk of substitution (through innovation, colour and support).

- Work collaboratively to manage specified projects through the lead specification stages to the sales opportunity pipeline conversion.

Qualifications
- Over 2 year's experience in a product sales role in the construction or related industry.

- Product knowledge and a firm understanding of the construction industry, including contractual relationships and knowledge of legislation.

- Ability to prepare reports/ presentations and able to analyze and share information to deadlines.

- Role requires travel within/ without the territory and overnight stays.

The PPG Financial Leadership Development (FLD) Program is a selective and premier rotational program designed to develop the next generation of finance leaders at PPG. For more than 40 years, the program has served as a pipeline for top talent, providing participants with the experiences, training, and mentorship needed to build successful careers across the organization.
During your first year, you will participate in a structured onboarding and development experience designed to accelerate your growth and help you build a foundation in finance at PPG.
